course_summary:
ISEN 613 | Engineering Data Analysis | Spring 2026
Instructor: Madhav Erraguntla | merraguntla@tamu.edu
Meets: TR 8:00-9:15 AM | Zach 345
Grading: Homework [30%], Midterm Exam [35%], Final Project [35%] — A: 90-100%, B: 80-89.9%, C: 70-79.9%, D: 60-69.9%, F: below 60%
Topics: LDA, QDA, KNN, LASSO, Ridge regression, Bootstrap, Support vector machines, Principal component analysis (PCA), Tree

chunks.content:
### Course Description

Selected topics in probability and data analysis for quality in engineering problems; measurement principles, data collection and data analysis to solve quality engineering problems; introduction to courses in the assurance sciences-reliability, maintainability, quality control and robust design.

chunks.content:
### Grading Policy

Grades assigned are: A for 90% - 100%, B for 80% - 89.9%, C for 70% - 79.9%, D for 60% - 69.9%, F for below 60%.

Any disagreements regarding a grade received on any graded material must be discussed within two business days from posting of the grades. No grade will be changed beyond the two business days limit. Grades will be maintained in the gradebook within Canvas.

Homework is an important element of this course and should be performed individually. Sharing of work in any manner is a violation of academic integrity. Homework are supposed to be independent work, and use of solutions from websites or other resources are prohibited. Late submission of homework is strictly not allowed and the link to submit your work will promptly be unavailable after the scheduled due date. The course assessment will be based on

- 30% Homework

- 35% Midterm Exam

- 35% Final Project

### Late Work Policy

Late submission of homework is strictly not allowed and the link to submit your work will promptly be unavailable after the scheduled due date. It is your responsibility to plan for contingencies such as internet being slow, canvas down at the last minute, submission delayed by a few minutes, etc.
